name: ark-host
description: Ark Ascended & Evolved server manager panel

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ark-host/shared && npm run build -w @ark-host/daemon && npm run build -w @ark-host/panel && npm run build -w @ark-host/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ark-host/shared && concurrently -n shared,daemon,panel,web -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @ark-host/shared" "npm run dev -w @ark-host/daemon" "npm run dev -w @ark-host/panel" "npm run dev -w @ark-host/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ark-host/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ark-host/daemon && npm run typecheck -w @ark-host/panel && npm run typecheck -w @ark-host/web
